nodes.question: How can the combination of smart grids, smart meters, smart buildings, and smart environmental monitoring benefit urban environments?
nodes.answer: The combination of these smart technologies can lead to energy efficiency improvement, renewable energy adoption, pollution reduction, and real-time energy and material flow feedback, providing numerous benefits for urban areas.
